Creative case study

Ecommerce

A product-first story designed to turn everyday browsing into a clear next step.

CategoryOnline retail
PlatformsFacebook & Instagram
FormatProduct discovery
TypeCreative concept

The brief

A shopper has seconds to understand what is being sold and why it matters. The creative needs a recognisable shopping moment, a focused benefit, and a simple path to the product.

The creative
direction.

The existing mobile-shopping footage becomes the opening visual. Pair it with one product benefit, a concise offer, and a final shop-now frame. Keep the message readable without sound and build the landing page around the same offer.

01 / Opening hook

Find your next everyday favourite.

An example opening line to test with this footage.

02 / Next step

Explore the collection

One action, aligned with the offer and the destination.

03 / Measurement

Track what matters.

Product-page visits, add-to-cart rate, purchases, and cost per purchase.

This is a creative concept using licensed stock footage already featured on our site. Performance is measured after a campaign launches; no client results are claimed here.
